source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 12 exercise hal (PDF 288-290): MCQs jawab aur wajah ke saath, short aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab, Frost diagram lafzon mein, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 12 (Nitrogen and Sulfur) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab diye gaye hain. Frost diagram aur structures lafzon mein bayan kiye gaye hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
I. Despite being the most abundant gas in the Earth’s atmosphere, nitrogen does not readily participate in combustion reactions because:
(Fiza mein sab se zyada hone ke bawajood nitrogen combustion (jalne) ki reactions mein asaani se hissa kyun nahi leti?)

options.text: Yeh oxygen se zyada ghani (dense) hai
Is ki specific heat capacity zyada hai
N≡N bond todne ke liye bohat zyada energy chahiye

blocks.explanation: N≡N triple bond ki bond enthalpy +944 kJ mol⁻¹ hai; ise todne ke liye itni energy chahiye ke N₂ bohat kam reactive hai (12.1). Nitrogen noble gas nahi.

blocks.prompt:
II. A student heats a solid ammonium salt with a solution of a strong alkali. The gas produced turns damp red litmus paper blue and has a characteristic pungent smell. The gas is:
(Ammonium salt ko strong alkali ke saath garam karne se aisi gas nikli jo geela surkh litmus neela karti hai aur tez boo wali hai. Gas kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Alkali ammonium salt se ammonia nikal deta hai; NH₃ basic hai (surkh litmus neela) aur tez boo wali, yahi ammonium ka test hai (12.2.3):
2NH₄Cl + Ca(OH)₂ → CaCl₂ + 2H₂O + 2NH₃

blocks.prompt:
III. The shape of ammonium is
(Ammonium (NH₄⁺) ki shakal kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: NH₃ lone pair ki wajah se pyramidal hai; jab yeh lone pair H⁺ se bond banata hai to NH₄⁺ ke chaar barabar N–H bonds hote hain aur shakal tetrahedral hoti hai (12.2.2).

blocks.prompt:
IV. In a catalytic converter, the conversion of nitrogen oxides (NOₓ) into nitrogen gas (N₂) and oxygen gas (O₂) is a process of:
(Catalytic converter mein NOₓ ka N₂ aur O₂ mein badalna kaun sa amal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen +2 (NO) ya +4 (NO₂) se 0 (N₂) par aati hai: oxidation number kam hota hai, is liye NOₓ reduce hota hai. Chapter mein 2NO + 2CO → N₂ + 2CO₂ 'Reduction' ke neeche hai (12.6).

blocks.prompt:
V. PAN formation starts when______ reacts with the hydrocarbon.
(PAN banna tab shuru hota hai jab ______ hydrocarbon se reaction kare.)
blocks.explanation: Chapter ke mutabiq ozone (oxidizing smog ka bara hissa) reactive hydrocarbon ko aldehyde mein badalti hai; phir aldehyde HO• se acyl radical, O₂ se peroxyacyl radical aur NO₂ se PAN banata hai (12.5.2, Figure 12.5).

blocks.prompt:
VI. Nitrification is the process by which:
(Nitrification kis amal ko kehte hain?)

options.text: Hawa ki nitrogen ammonia mein badalti hai
Nitrate nitrogen gas mein badalta hai
Ammonia pehle nitrite aur phir nitrate mein badalti hai
Organic nitrogen ammonia mein badalti hai

blocks.explanation: Nitrification mein ammonium/ammonia (NH₄⁺) pehle nitrite (NO₂⁻) aur phir nitrate (NO₃⁻) banti hai; (b) denitrification hai (12.7).

blocks.prompt:
VII. The most stable species in an acidic environment is
(Acidic mahol mein sab se stable species kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Frost diagram (Figure 12.9) mein sab se stable species sab se neeche wala point hai. Acidic solution mein H₂S(g) sab se neeche hai (S₈ ke 0 se bhi neeche), jabke SO₂ aur SO₄²⁻ oopar hain; acidic halat mein sulfur ki tamam oxidized halatein element se kam stable hain (12.9).

blocks.prompt:
VIII. Which gas is used in separating hard water from normal water?
(Kaun si gas 'hard water' (asal mein heavy water) ko aam pani se alag karne mein istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sawal ka matlab heavy water (D₂O) hai. Ise aam pani se Girdler sulfide process se alag kiya jata hai, jis mein hydrogen sulfide pani ke saath deuterium ka tabadla karti hai (chapter se bahar).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: 'hard water' ghalat chhapa hai; murad heavy water (D₂O) hai. Hard water mein Ca²⁺ aur Mg²⁺ ke namak hote hain aur use kisi gas se alag nahi kiya jata; heavy water H₂S ki madad se aam pani se alag hota hai (Girdler sulfide process, chapter se bahar).

blocks.prompt:
IX. The oxidation state of sulfur in H₂SO₄ is
(H₂SO₄ mein sulfur ki oxidation state kya hai?)

X. In a Frost diagram, a species that lies above the line connecting its neighbors is:
(Frost diagram mein jo species apne padosiyon ko jorne wali lakeer se oopar ho, woh:)
blocks.explanation: Jo point padosiyon ko jorne wali lakeer se oopar ho us ki free energy un do padosiyon ke mixture se zyada hoti hai, is liye woh un mein badalne ki taraf mayel hai (aik oonchi aur aik neechi oxidation state): disproportionation (diagram 12.9 mein; yeh usool chapter ke text se bahar hai).

blocks.prompt:
XI. Sulfur dioxide (SO₂) produced from the combustion of sulfur can be further oxidized to sulfur trioxide (SO₃) under specific conditions, such as in the presence of a:
(SO₂ ko SO₃ mein badalne ke liye kis cheez ki maujoodgi zaroori hai?)

options.text: Catalyst (misal vanadium(V) oxide) aur zyada temperature
Strong reducing agent aur zyada pressure

blocks.explanation: Contact process mein SO₂ aur hawa 420-450 °C tak garam kar ke 1-2 atm par V₂O₅ catalyst par guzarte hain: SO₂ + ½O₂ ⇌ SO₃ (12.13.1).

blocks.prompt:
XII. Sulfur trioxide (SO₃) is not directly dissolved in water to produce sulfuric acid in the Contact Process because this reaction is:
(Contact process mein SO₃ ko seedha pani mein kyun nahi ghola jata?)

options.text: Reversible hai aur kam paidawar deti
Bohat zyada heat deti hai aur sulfuric acid ki dhund (mist) banati hai

blocks.explanation: SO₃ + H₂O → H₂SO₄ bohat zyada exothermic hai (ΔH = −176.6 kJ mol⁻¹); liquid ki bajaye acid ki bhaap ya dhund banti hai. Is liye SO₃ ko 98.5% H₂SO₄ mein jazb kar ke oleum banaya jata hai (12.13.1).

blocks.prompt:
a. List two reasons for the inertness of N₂.
N₂ ke kam reactive (inert) hone ki do wajoohat likhein.
blocks.explanation:
1. N≡N triple bond bohat mazboot hai (bond enthalpy +944 kJ mol⁻¹), ise todne ke liye bohat energy chahiye.
2. Bond non-polar hai: dono atoms aik jaise hain (electronegativity ka farq zero), electrons barabar bate hain aur hamle ke liye koi charged jagah nahi.
(Chhota size aur symmetrical electron cloud bhi wajah hain.)

blocks.prompt:
b. How is nitrogen isolated from air?
Hawa se nitrogen kaise alag ki jati hai?
blocks.explanation:
Sanat (industry) mein hawa ko itna thanda kiya jata hai ke liquid ban jaye; phir nitrogen (boiling point −195.8 °C) liquid hawa se ubal kar alag ho jati hai (liquid hawa ki fractional distillation).
Lab mein nitrogen ammonium nitrite ko halka garam kar ke banti hai: NH₄NO₂ → (garmi) N₂ + 2H₂O.

blocks.prompt:
c. Why ammonia (NH₃) is a weak base?
Ammonia weak base kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Pani mein NH₃ ka sirf thora hissa proton leta hai: NH₃ + H₂O ⇌ NH₄⁺ + OH⁻. Is ka basicity constant kam hai (Kb = 1.8 × 10⁻⁵) aur equilibrium bohat baayein taraf hai, is liye kam OH⁻ ions bante hain.

blocks.prompt:
d. How does NO₂ catalyze the formation of SO₃?
NO₂ SO₃ banne mein catalyst ka kaam kaise karti hai?
blocks.explanation:
(Chapter se bahar: purana lead chamber process.) NO₂ SO₂ ko SO₃ mein oxidize karti hai aur khud NO ban jati hai; hawa NO ko dobara NO₂ bana deti hai, is liye yeh wapas mil jati hai aur catalyst ka kaam karti hai:
SO₂ + NO₂ → SO₃ + NO
2NO + O₂ → 2NO₂
Kul: 2SO₂ + O₂ → 2SO₃

blocks.prompt:
e. Write down the reactions of photochemical smog formation.
Photochemical smog banne ki reactions likhein.
blocks.explanation:
N₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO(g) (engines mein, zyada temperature par)
2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g)
NO₂(g) → (dhoop, hν) NO(g) + O(g)
O(g) + O₂(g) → O₃(g)
O₃ aur NOₓ dhoop mein hydrocarbons (VOCs) se reaction kar ke aldehydes aur peroxyacyl radicals banate hain, jo NO₂ se mil kar PAN banate hain: RC(O)OO• + NO₂ → RC(O)OONO₂

blocks.prompt:
f. What is the construction and function of a catalytic converter?
Catalytic converter ki banawat aur kaam kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Banawat: ceramic ya dhaat (metal) ka honeycomb (shehad ke chhatte) jaisa dhancha; is ki naaliyon par alumina ki teh (zyada surface area) jis par Pt, Pd aur Rh phailaye hote hain.
Kaam (three-way): exhaust ki nuqsan deh CO, NO aur hydrocarbons ko CO₂, N₂ aur H₂O mein badalta hai:
2NO + 2CO → (Pt/Rh) N₂ + 2CO₂ (NO ki reduction)
2CO + O₂ → (Pt/Rh) 2CO₂ (oxidation)
C₂H₄ + 3O₂ → (Pt/Rh) 2CO₂ + 2H₂O (oxidation)

blocks.prompt:
g. Why sulfur is quite unreactive at room temperature?
Room temperature par sulfur kam reactive kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Room temperature par sulfur mustahkam S₈ taaj (crown) shakal ki rings mein hota hai jin mein har S atom mazboot S–S single bonds se jura hai (catenation). Reaction se pehle yeh bonds todne parte hain jis ke liye garmi chahiye; is liye sulfur zyada tar garam karne par reaction karta hai (misal jal kar SO₂) aur aam halat mein pani ya dilute non-oxidising acids se reaction nahi karta.

blocks.prompt:
h. Which are the most stable oxidation states of sulphur in water at pH=0 and pH=14?
pH = 0 aur pH = 14 par pani mein sulfur ki sab se stable oxidation states kaun si hain?
blocks.explanation:
Frost diagram se (sab se neeche wala point sab se stable):
pH = 0 (acidic): −2, yani H₂S; tamam oxidized halatein (SO₂, SO₄²⁻) elemental sulfur se oopar hain.
pH = 14 (basic): +6, yani SO₄²⁻, sab se neeche; tamam oxidized halatein elemental sulfur se zyada stable hain.

blocks.prompt:
i. How does sulfur react with halogens?
Sulfur halogens se kaise reaction karta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Fluorine se sulfur seedha SF₄ aur SF₆ banata hai: S(s) + 3F₂(g) → SF₆(g) (bohat kam reactive gas, bijli ke aalaat mein insulator).
Chlorine se S₂Cl₂ (peela liquid) banta hai, jo mazeed Cl₂ se SCl₂ (surkh liquid) deta hai:
2S(s) + Cl₂(g) → S₂Cl₂(l)
S₂Cl₂(l) + Cl₂(g) → 2SCl₂(l)

blocks.prompt:
j. Draw the structures of cyclo-octasulfur (S₈) and sulfuric acid.
S₈ aur sulfuric acid ki structures banayein.
blocks.explanation:
S₈ (lafzon mein): aath S atoms aik tedhi, taaj (crown) shakal ki ring mein jure; har S apne do padosiyon se single bonds banata hai aur us par do lone pairs hain. Side se dekhein to atoms baari baari oopar neeche hain (chaar oopar, chaar neeche).
H₂SO₄: beech mein S atom, chaar O atoms tetrahedral tarteeb mein; do O double bond se (S=O) aur do OH groups single bond se (S–O–H):
(HO)₂S(=O)₂

blocks.prompt:
k. What is the role of sulfur in the vulcanization of rubber?
Rubber ki vulcanization mein sulfur ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation: Sulfur cross-linker ka kaam karta hai: rubber ke saath garam karne par yeh lambi rubber polymer chains ke darmiyan S–S pul (cross-links) banata hai. Juri hui chains aasani se aik doosre par phisal nahi saktin, is liye rubber ki mazbooti barh jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
l. What is the composition and the chemical reaction of gunpowder combustion?
Gunpowder ki banawat (composition) aur jalne ki reaction kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Banawat: 75% potassium nitrate (KNO₃, oxidiser), 15% lakri ka koyla (charcoal, asal fuel) aur 10% sulfur (izafi fuel jo powder ko tezi se jalata hai).
Reaction: 10KNO₃(s) + 3S(s) + 8C(s) → 2K₂CO₃(s) + 3K₂SO₄(s) + 6CO₂(g) + 5N₂(g)

blocks.prompt:
m. What is the importance of disulfide bridges?
Disulfide bridges ki kya ahmiyat hai?
blocks.explanation: Disulfide bridges chains ke darmiyan S–S jor hain. Vulcanized rubber mein yeh polymer chains ko aapas mein jor kar rubber ko mazboot banate hain. (Chapter se bahar: proteins mein cysteine units ke darmiyan S–S bridges muri hui chains ko un ki shakal mein qaim rakhte hain.)

blocks.prompt:
n. Write down self-ionization equation of sulfuric acid and its ionization in water.
Sulfuric acid ki self-ionization aur pani mein ionization ki equations likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Self-ionization (autoprotolysis): H₂SO₄(l) + H₂SO₄(l) ⇌ H₃SO₄⁺ + HSO₄⁻, K = 2.7 × 10⁻⁴
Pani mein ionization:
H₂SO₄(aq) + H₂O(l) ⇌ H₃O⁺(aq) + HSO₄⁻(aq) (pKa1 = −2, strong)
HSO₄⁻(aq) + H₂O(l) ⇌ H₃O⁺(aq) + SO₄²⁻(aq) (pKa2 = 1.92, kamzor)

blocks.prompt:
o. Give two examples where sulfuric acid acts as a dehydrating agent.
Sulfuric acid ke dehydrating agent hone ki do misalein dein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Cheeni (sugar): C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁(s) → (conc. H₂SO₄) 12C(s) + 11H₂O(g); carbon ka kaala, masaam-daar dher ('carbon snake') banta hai.
2. Ethanol: C₂H₅OH → (conc. H₂SO₄, garmi) C₂H₄(g) + H₂O

blocks.prompt:
p. How does V₂O₅ catalyze the formation of SO₃?
V₂O₅ SO₃ banne mein catalyst kaise banta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh 420-450 °C aur 1-2 atm par do qadam mein kaam karta hai:
1. V⁵⁺ SO₂ ko oxidize karta hai aur khud V⁴⁺ ban jata hai: SO₂ + V₂O₅ → SO₃ + V₂O₄
2. Oxygen V⁴⁺ ko wapas V⁵⁺ banati hai, catalyst dobara mil jata hai: V₂O₄ + ½O₂ → V₂O₅
Kul: SO₂ + ½O₂ ⇌ SO₃

blocks.prompt:
q. What is purpose of formation of oleum?
Oleum banane ka maqsad kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
SO₃ ko seedha pani mein nahi daal sakte: reaction bohat zyada garmi deti hai aur acid ki dhund banti hai. Is liye SO₃ ko 98.5% H₂SO₄ mein jazb kar ke oleum banaya jata hai, jise phir pani se patla kar ke zaroorat ke concentration wala H₂SO₄ banta hai:
H₂SO₄ + SO₃ → H₂S₂O₇ (oleum)
H₂S₂O₇ + H₂O → 2H₂SO₄

blocks.prompt:
Q.3 Explain the preparation and basicity of ammonia.
Ammonia ki tayyari aur us ki basicity bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Tayyari:
1. Sanati (Haber-Bosch process): N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g). (Aam halat, iron catalyst, taqreeban 450 °C aur zyada pressure, chapter se bahar hain.)
2. Lab: ammonium salt ko base (misal calcium hydroxide) ke saath garam kiya jata hai:
2NH₄Cl(s) + Ca(OH)₂ → CaCl₂ + 2H₂O(l) + 2NH₃(g)
NH₄⁺ acid (H⁺ deta hai) aur OH⁻ base ka kaam karta hai. Test tube ko munh ki taraf thora neeche jhuka kar kasa jata hai taake pani garam sheeshe par wapas na aaye. Test: tez boo wali gas jo geela surkh litmus neela kare, ammonium ki nishani hai.
Basicity:
1. NH₃ Lowry-Bronsted base hai; proton leti hai: NH₃(aq) + H⁺(aq) → NH₄⁺(aq)
2. Pani mein: NH₃(aq) + H₂O(l) ⇌ NH₄⁺(aq) + OH⁻(aq), Kb = 1.8 × 10⁻⁵. Kam Kb aur bohat baayein taraf equilibrium ki wajah se ammonia solution weak base hai.
3. N ka lone pair H⁺ leta hai, is liye NH₃ (pyramidal) NH₄⁺ (tetrahedral, chaar barabar N–H bonds) ban jati hai; NH₃ Lewis base bhi hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki lab equation mein products mein NaCl chhapa hai aur equation balanced nahi; sahi balanced equation upar di gayi hai: 2NH₄Cl + Ca(OH)₂ → CaCl₂ + 2H₂O + 2NH₃.

blocks.prompt:
Q.4 How oxides of nitrogen (NOₓ) cause the formation of photochemical smog and PAN? Give its mechanism.
NOₓ photochemical smog aur PAN kaise banate hain? Mechanism dein.
blocks.explanation:
Photochemical smog dhoop mein NOₓ aur volatile organic compounds (VOCs) se banti hai; yeh oxidising hai (NO₂, O₃ aur PANs).
NOₓ aur ozone ka banna:
N₂ + O₂ → 2NO (engines mein, zyada temperature par)
2NO + O₂ → 2NO₂
NO₂ → (hν) NO + O
O + O₂ → O₃
PAN banne ka mechanism (Figure 12.5):
1. Ozone reactive hydrocarbon ko oxidize kar ke alkyl radical RCH₂• banati hai.
2. RCH₂• + O₂ → RCH₂O₂• (peroxy radical)
3. RCH₂O₂• + NO → RCH₂O• + NO₂
4. RCH₂O• + O₂ → RCHO (aldehyde) + HO₂•
5. HO₂• + NO → NO₂ + HO•; HO• mazeed hydrocarbon (RCH₃) par hamla karta hai aur cycle chalta rehta hai.
6. Aldehyde hydroxyl radical se: RCHO + HO• → RC•=O (acyl radical) + H₂O
7. RC•=O + O₂ → RC(O)OO• (peroxyacyl radical)
8. RC(O)OO• + NO₂ → RC(O)OONO₂ (peroxyacyl nitrate, PAN); R = CH₃ ho to peroxyacetyl nitrate.
Cycle mein NO dobara NO₂ ban jata hai, is liye NOₓ musalsal O₃ aur PAN banate rehte hain jo aankhon mein jalan aur jandaron ko nuqsan dete hain.

blocks.prompt:
Q.5 Frost diagram explains the stabilities of different oxidation states of sulfur. Which oxidation states of sulphur are the most stable at acidic and basic conditions?
Frost diagram sulfur ki mukhtalif oxidation states ki stability batata hai. Acidic aur basic halat mein sab se stable oxidation states kaun si hain?
blocks.explanation:
Frost diagram: nE⁰ (couple X(n)/X(0) ke liye) aur oxidation state n ka graph, pH = 0 aur pH = 14 ke liye. Kyunke −ΔG°/F = nE⁰, neecha point zyada negative ΔG° hai, is liye sab se stable oxidation state sab se neeche wala point hai. Zyada positive dhalwan (slope) wala couple acha oxidising agent, zyada negative slope wala acha reducing agent hai.
Sulfur ka diagram (Figure 12.9, lafzon mein): acidic lakeer H₂S(g) (−2, zero se thora neeche) se S₈ (0, zero par) tak, phir tezi se SO₂(aq) (+4) se SO₄²⁻ (+6, sab se oopar) tak charhti hai. Basic lakeer S²⁻ (−2, zero se oopar) se S₈ (0) tak, phir SO₃²⁻ (+4) se SO₄²⁻ (+6, sab se neeche) tak girti hai.
Acidic halat (pH = 0): −2 state (H₂S) sab se stable; tamam oxidized halatein elemental sulfur se oopar hain, aur SO₄²⁻ bohat unstable yani strong oxidising hai.
Basic halat (pH = 14): +6 state (SO₄²⁻) sab se stable aur bilkul non-oxidising; tamam oxidized halatein elemental sulfur se zyada stable hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Frost diagram parhne ka asaan usool: jitna neeche, utna stable. Acid mein neeche H₂S hai, base mein neeche SO₄²⁻ hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q.6 Discuss sulfuric acid as an oxidizing agent and a dehydrating agent with three reactions for each.
Sulfuric acid ko oxidizing agent aur dehydrating agent ke tor par teen teen reactions ke saath bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Oxidizing agent ke tor par: SO₄²⁻ khud kamzor oxidising hai, lekin garam concentrated H₂SO₄ darmiyani strong oxidising agent hai (zyada temperature aur zyada protons ki wajah se); yeh khud SO₂ mein reduce hota hai.
1. Cu(s) + 2H₂SO₄(conc) → CuSO₄ + SO₂(g) + 2H₂O (ionic: Cu + 2H₂SO₄ → Cu²⁺ + SO₄²⁻ + SO₂ + 2H₂O)
2. Zn(s) + 2H₂SO₄(conc) → ZnSO₄ + SO₂(g) + 2H₂O
3. C(s) + 2H₂SO₄(conc) → CO₂(g) + 2SO₂(g) + 2H₂O (chapter se bahar)
Dehydrating agent ke tor par: concentrated H₂SO₄ compounds se pani (ya H aur O 2:1 ki nisbat mein) nikal leta hai, carbon, bhaap aur garmi paida hoti hai.
1. C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁(s) → (conc. H₂SO₄) 12C(s) + 11H₂O(g) (cheeni jal kar kaala 'carbon snake')
2. C₂H₅OH(l) → (conc. H₂SO₄, garmi) C₂H₄(g) + H₂O (ethanol se ethene; doosri halat mein ethoxyethane)
3. H₂C₂O₄ → (conc. H₂SO₄) CO(g) + CO₂(g) + H₂O (oxalic acid; chapter se bahar)

items: MCQs ke jawab: I c, II c, III c, IV b, V c, VI c, VII c, VIII b, IX d, X c, XI a, XII c.
Frost diagram: acid (pH 0) mein sab se stable H₂S (−2), base (pH 14) mein sab se stable SO₄²⁻ (+6).
Kitab ki ghalti: MCQ VIII mein 'hard water' ki jagah heavy water (D₂O) hona chahiye.
